title: Concept2 Rest Interval Drift Beyond Plan
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=concept2:workout piece_type=interval
| stats avg(rest_interval_sec) as avg_rest_interval, avg(target_rest_sec) as target_rest_sec by workout_id athlete
| where target_rest_sec>0 AND avg_rest_interval>target_rest_sec*1.2
| sort - avg_rest_interval
description: Uses Concept2 interval sessions telemetry to monitor rest behavior versus the programmed recovery window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sessions where recovery drifted away from the plan, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Concept2 interval sessions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Comparison table of planned and actual rest intervals.
grandmaExplanation: It turns rest behavior versus the programmed recovery window so you can spot sessions where recovery drifted away from the plan before it becomes annoying.
